test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_alias_pushdown_logs ( ts UInt64, raw_attrs Map(String, String), __mat_service String MATERIALIZED raw_attrs['service'], hot_attrs Map(String, String), cold_attrs Map(String, String), attrs_masked Map(String, String) ALIAS mapApply( (k, v) -> (k, multiIf( k = 'ssn', '***', k = 'email', concat('***@', splitByChar('@', v)[2]), v )), mapFilter((k, v) -> k NOT IN ('secret_drop', 'audit_only'), raw_attrs) ), attrs_split Map(String, String) ALIAS mapUpdate( mapFilter((k, v) -> k NOT IN ('service', 'status'), cold_attrs), mapFilter((k, v) -> k IN ('service', 'status'), hot_attrs) ), merged_c Map(String, String), merged_a Map(String, String) ALIAS mapApply( (k, v) -> (substring(k, 3), v), mapFilter((k, v) -> startsWith(k, 'a.'), merged_c) ) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (__mat_service, ts) SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_alias_pushdown_logs SELECT number AS ts, cast(( ['service', 'env', 'ssn', 'email', 'secret_drop', 'k1', 'k2', 'k3', 'k4', 'k5'], [concat('svc_', toString(number % 20)), 'prod', '123-45', concat('user', toString(number % 100), '@example.com'), 'hidden', 'v1', 'v2', 'v3', 'v4', toString(number)] ), 'Map(String, String)') AS raw_attrs, map('service', concat('svc_', toString(number % 20)), 'status', '200') AS hot_attrs, map('trace_id', toString(number), 'host', 'h1', 'region', 'us-east') AS cold_attrs, map('a.foo', toString(number), 'a.bar', 'bar', 'b.baz', 'baz') AS merged_c FROM numbers_mt(200000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT count() FROM perf_alias_pushdown_logs WHERE attrs_masked['service'] = 'svc_7'
SELECT count() FROM perf_alias_pushdown_logs WHERE NOT ignore(attrs_masked['secret_drop'])
SELECT count() FROM perf_alias_pushdown_logs WHERE attrs_masked['email'] = '***@example.com'
SELECT count() FROM perf_alias_pushdown_logs WHERE attrs_split['service'] = 'svc_7'
SELECT count() FROM perf_alias_pushdown_logs WHERE merged_a['foo'] = '42'
